image_description: A low-resolution, cropped image showing the dorsal surface of a large marine mammal swimming in turquoise water. The visible portion includes the back and part of the head/rostrum area. The skin appears mottled grey with lighter patches, consistent with barnacle encrustation. No dorsal fin is visible, but a series of low humps (knuckles) can be seen along the ridge of the back.
